source.description:
## PROBLEM

package.json 'files' includes '.xtrm/skills/default' wholesale. npm pack honours 'files' and
.npmignore, NOT .gitignore. So a directory that is gitignored but present on disk still gets
packed.

.xtrm/skills/default/gitnexus/ is gitignored at .gitignore:181 and is present in this working
copy (mtime 2026-07-13, 6 skill directories, 0 tracked files).

Result, in this checkout:

  npm run check:registry-pack-parity
    Missing from npm pack: none
    Missing from registry:
    - .xtrm/skills/default/gitnexus/gitnexus-cli/SKILL.md
    - ... 6 files

Verified NOT caused by any current change: the same failure appears with the working registry
edit stashed.

## WHY CI IS GREEN

CI packs from a fresh clone, where a gitignored directory does not exist. So the check passes
there and fails only on a developer or agent machine that has the local gitnexus skills.

## ACTUAL RISK — narrow, but real

core and xtmux publish from CI, so they are safe today. specialists publishes LOCALLY
(release_execute.py: 'run npm publish --access public locally'), so a local publish from a
polluted tree would ship files the registry does not list. specialists does not currently have
this directory, which is the only reason it has not happened.

## SUCCESS

- npm pack never includes a path that .gitignore excludes, or the parity check explains the
  difference instead of reporting a bare mismatch.
- Simplest shape: add the same exclusion to the 'files' negations, next to the existing
  '!**/__pycache__/**' entries.
- A local 'npm pack' from a polluted working copy produces the same file list as a clean clone.

## NON_GOALS

Removing the local gitnexus skills. They are deliberately gitignored and useful locally.

## NOT A RELEASE BLOCKER

Recorded during the 2026-07-27 release preparation. core publishes via CI; specialists lacks the
directory. Verify the specialists tree is clean immediately before its local npm publish.
